summary: Ran 20 pytest backend tests against Ride91 API via public URL — all passed (100%). Covered health, phone+OTP auth (idempotent /verify, bad-OTP 400, /me auth-guard), append-only duty_states (auth-required, client_action_id dedup, ordered segments/totals/current_state), close-outs (idempotent), money/today (per-platform gross, 30% share math, cash_over_limit flag toggled by seeding a 2000-INR close-out, payable = share - cash - advance_recovery), money/weekly (exactly 7 days, oldest -> newest), requests (idempotent create + list), tracking heartbeat and phone ping (auth), and vehicle_pings ingest (no-auth stub + accuracy_m > 30 filter verified with an 11 km displaced ping at accuracy_m=80).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI on_event('startup'/'shutdown') hooks — should migrate to a lifespan context manager (non-blocking; still works today).
OTP request is upserted per phone but /verify accepts DEMO_OTP unconditionally — fine for demo per PRD; ensure this path is disabled in prod builds.
server.py is ~713 lines; approaching the 700-line split threshold — consider splitting into routers/ (auth, duty, money, tracking, seed) as the app grows.
_distance_today streams ALL vehicle_pings for the vehicle then filters in Python; add a Mongo range query on recorded_at + accuracy_m for scale.
seed_data_creation: Server auto-seeds one demo driver (+919900000001), vehicle KA-01-EV-0091, ~1 day of vehicle_pings and 5 duty rows on first boot. Tests appended additional TEST_ close-outs, duty rows, and requests using unique client_action_ids — safe (append-only, idempotent).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints listed in the review request are green. Idempotency verified via client_action_id on /auth/otp/verify, /duty/state, /close-out, /requests. Accuracy filter (>30 m) confirmed by inserting a ping 11 km away at accuracy_m=80 and observing distance_km delta < 1 km. EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is the correct env key (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) — conftest reads it via python-dotenv from /app/frontend/.env.
